各位股東：                        Dear Shareholders,

本人欣然提呈建發國際投資集團有限公            I am pleased to present the annual report of C&D International
司（「建發國際集團」或「本公司」，連同其         Investment Group Limited (“C&D International Group” or the
附屬公司統稱「本集團」）截至二零二四年          “Company”, and together with its subsidiaries, the “Group”) for
十二月三十一日止年度（「本年度」）之報          the year ended 31 December 2024 (the “Year”).
告：

一、經濟環境形勢回顧                   I.    REVIEW OF ECONOMIC LANDSCAPE
   二零二四年，是中國房地產行業面                 The year 2024 posed immense challenges for China’s
   臨巨大挑戰的一年。宏觀經濟的週                 real estate industry. Macroeconomic cyclical adjustment,
   期調整疊加行業深度調整，客戶不                 compounded by profound structural shifts within the
   敢投資消費、觀望情緒濃厚，使得                 sector, resulted in hesitant investment and consumption
   房企面臨前所未有的壓力，這一年                 by customers, coupled with a pervasive wait-and-see
   是考驗嚴峻的行業寒冬。                     sentiment. This has subjected real estate companies to
                                   unprecedented pressure, marking 2024 as a harsh winter of
                                   severe trials for the industry.

   從政策環境看，二零二四年中央持                 From the perspective of the policy environment, the
   續推出一系列寬鬆的財政、貨幣等                 central government continued to introduce a series of
   刺激政策，以及一系列穩樓市、促                 accommodative fiscal and monetary stimulus measures in
   消費的政策，為樓市的企穩奠定了                 2024, along with various policies aimed at stabilizing the
   基礎，第四季度也在政策提振下，                 property market and boosting consumption, which laid the
   行業開始出現「止跌回穩」的勢頭。                groundwork for market stabilization. By the fourth quarter,
                                   under the support of these policies, the industry began to
                                   show signs of “bottoming out and stabilizing”.

   從行業需求看，房地產行業的總量                 From the perspective of industry demand, while the overall
   是足夠的，但也出現結構性的需求                 demand for real estate remains sufficient, structural shifts
   變化，客戶對於房屋品質、地段、                 in demand have emerged. Customers are placing higher
   功能、環境、配套和服務等方面提                 demands on housing quality, location, functionality,
   出了更高的要求，核心區域的改善                 environment, supporting facilities and services, with the
   性住房需求成為當前的主流需求。                 demand for improved housing in core areas becoming the
                                   dominant trend.

   從競爭格局看，當前房企面臨多維                 From the perspective of competitive landscape, real estate
   化的競爭，由產品競爭、品牌競爭                 companies are facing increasingly diversified competition,
   增加到了技術競爭、供應鏈競爭、                 which has expanded from product and brand competition
   流 量 競 爭、資 料 競 爭、文 化 競 爭         to include technology, supply chain, traffic, data and
   等，因此，產品力、服務力、營運                 cultural competition. Consequently, real estate companies
   能力等綜合實力強的房企，將逐步                 with robust comprehensive capabilities in product quality,
   凸顯競爭優勢。                         service excellence, and operational efficiency, will gradually
                                   emerge as competitive leaders.

               MANAGEMENT DISCUSSION AND ANALYSIS


市場回顧                              MARKET REVIEW
二 零 二 四 年，是 中 國 房 地 產 行 業 面 臨 巨   The year 2024 posed immense challenges for China’s real estate
大 挑 戰 的 一 年。宏 觀 經 濟 的 週 期 調 整 疊   industry. Macroeconomic cyclical adjustment, compounded by
加 行 業 深 度 調 整，客 戶 不 敢 投 資 消 費、    profound structural shifts within the sector, resulted in hesitant
觀 望 情 緒 濃 厚，使 得 房 企 面 臨 前 所 未 有   investment and consumption by customers, coupled with a
的壓力，這一年是考驗嚴峻的行業寒冬。                pervasive wait-and-see sentiment. This has subjected property
                                  development companies to unprecedented pressure, marking
                                  2024 as a harsh winter of severe trials for the industry.

從 政 策 環 境 看，二 零 二 四 年 中 央 持 續 推   From the perspective of the policy environment, the central
出一系列寬鬆的財政、貨幣等刺激政策，                government continued to introduce a series of accommodative
以 及 一 系 列 穩 樓 市、促 消 費 的 政 策，為     fiscal and monetary stimulus measures in 2024, along with various
樓 市 的 企 穩 奠 定 了 基 礎，第 四 季 度 也 在   policies aimed at stabilizing the property market and boosting
政 策 提 振 下，行 業 開 始 出 現「止 跌 回 穩」    consumption, which laid the groundwork for market stabilization.
的勢頭。                              By the fourth quarter of 2024, under the support of these
                                  policies, the industry began to show signs of “bottoming out and
                                  stabilizing”.

從 行 業 需 求 看，房 地 產 行 業 的 總 量 是 足   From the perspective of industry demand, while the overall
夠 的，但 也 出 現 結 構 性 的 需 求 變 化，客     demand for real estate remains sufficient, structural shifts in
戶對於房屋品質、地段、功能、環境、配                demand have emerged. Customers are placing higher demands on
套 和 服 務 等 方 面 提 出 了 更 高 的 要 求，核   housing quality, location, functionality, environment, supporting
心區域的改善性住房需求成為當前的主                 facilities and services, with the demand for improved housing in
流需求。                              core areas becoming the dominant trend.

從 競 爭 格 局 看，當 前 房 企 面 臨 多 維 化 的   From the perspective of competitive landscape, property
競 爭，由 產 品 競 爭、品 牌 競 爭 增 加 到 了     development companies are facing increasingly diversified

董事會多元化政策                                     Board Diversity Policy
 本 公 司 訂 有 董 事 會 多 元 化 政 策，當 中 載             The Company has adopted a Board Diversity Policy which sets
 列董事會達致成員多元化而採取的方                            out the approach to achieve diversity of the Board. The Company
 針。本 公 司 一 直 重 視 及 期 待 董 事 會 多 元             recognises and embraces the benefits of having a diverse Board
 化 所 帶 來 的 好 處，並 視 董 事 會 層 面 日 益             and sees increasing diversity at the Board level as an essential
 多元化為維持本公司競爭優勢的關鍵元                           element in maintaining the Company’s competitive advantage.
 素。董 事 會 關 注 本 集 團 各 層 次 的 多 樣 性             The Board pays attention to diversity (including gender diversity)
（包 括 性 別 多 樣 性）。於 二 零 二 四 年 十 二              across all levels of the Group. The employee gender ratio of the
月 三 十 一 日，本 集 團 僱 員 的 性 別 比 例 為              Group as at 31 December 2024 is 67% male: 33% female. The
 67% 男：33% 女。本 集 團 認 為，性 別 比                 Group is in the view that the gender ratio is relatively satisfactory.
 例相對令人滿意。

根 據 董 事 會 多 元 化 政 策，提 名 委 員 會 將              Pursuant to the Board Diversity Policy, the Nomination Committee
每 年 檢 討 董 事 會 的 架 構、人 數 及 組 成，               will review annually the structure, size and composition of the
並在適當情況下就董事會變動提出建議，                           Board and where appropriate, make recommendations on
以 配 合 本 公 司 的 企 業 策 略，確 保 董 事 會              changes to the Board to complement the Company’s corporate
能 保 持 均 衡 的 多 元 化。在 檢 討 和 評 估 董              strategy and to ensure that the Board maintains a balanced
事 會 組 成 方 面，提 名 委 員 會 致 力 於 各 層              diverse profile. In relation to reviewing and assessing the Board
級達致多元化，並將考慮包括（但不限於）                          composition, the Nomination Committee is committed to diversity
性 別、年 齡、文 化 及 教 育 背 景、專 業 資                  at all levels and will consider a number of aspects, including but
格、技 能、知 識 以 及 行 業 及 地 區 經 驗 等                not limited to gender, age, cultural and educational background,
多個方面。                                        professional qualifications, skills, knowledge and industry and
                                             regional experience.

本公司旨在適當平衡與本公司業務成長                            The Company aims to maintain an appropriate balance of
相關的多樣觀點，並致力確保各層面（自                           diversity perspectives that are relevant to the Company’s business
董事會層級由上而下）的招聘及篩選慣例                           growth and is also committed to ensuring that recruitment and
方面的架構恰當，能充分考慮各樣候選人。                          selection practices at all levels (from the Board downwards) are
                                             appropriately structured so that a diverse range of candidates are
                                             considered.

董事會將考慮為執行董事會多元化政策                            The Board will consider setting measurable objectives to

                                       DEVELOPMENT

力。本 集 團 踐 行「積 極 進 取，合 作 共 贏」           term success of enterprises. The Group adheres to the core value
的核心價值觀，以「開拓新價值，讓更多                     of “proactive and aggressive, win-win cooperation”, and takes
人過上更有品質生活」作為使命，在發展                     “exploring new values, making more people live a better life” as
過 程 中 將 ESG 因 素 納 入 商 業 決 策，擔 當        the mission. In the course of development, the Group integrates

訪談、客戶滿意度調查、職工代表大會、                                      ways including official WeChat account, official website, face-to-
社交媒體等多種途徑對利益相關方開展                                       face interviews, customer satisfaction survey, employees’ meetings
調 研，了 解 其 對 各 項 ESG 議 題 的 關 注 程                         and social media, so as to understand the level of their concerns
度，並 結 合 本 集 團 業 務 發 展 情 況 對 ESG                         in respect of various ESG issues. Based on the Group’s business
議 題 的 重 要 性 進 行 綜 合 性 排 序，由 此 確                         development, the Group has prioritised the materiality of ESG
定年度 ESG 報告的披露重點。2024 年度，                                issues comprehensively to determine the disclosure focus of the

 議題識別
 Identification of issues

 結合本集團業務發展特點、行業 ESG 關注重點及宏觀環境，對上一年度 ESG 議題清單進行更新。
 Combining the characteristics of the Group’s business development, industry ESG focus and macro-environment, the list of ESG issues
 in the previous year is updated.


 溝通調研
 Communication survey

 通過訪談等形式，對內外部利益相關方的需求和期望進行深入了解。
 Through the way such as interviews, the Group can deeply understand the appeals and expectations of both internal and external
 stakeholders.


 重要性排序
 Materiality priority

 依據溝通和調研結果對 ESG 重要性議題進行排序，以此確定本報告的披露重點及未來可持續發展的管理重點。
 ESG materiality issues are prioritised based on the results of the communication survey. On this basis, the management attention for
 the Group’s future sustainable development and the key area of disclosure in this Report are determined.

                                          創新科技住宅
                           Residences Powered by Innovative Technology

科技住宅系統，即打造「恆溫、恆濕、恆氧、恆潔、恆靜」的室內「五恆系統」。本集團首個試點項目上海海
閱首府，主要採用了由空氣源熱泵、高效熱回收調濕新風機組、毛細管網、自控系統等組成的科技住宅系統，
旨在為業主高品質居住體驗。
The technology-empowered residence systems aim to create an indoor “Five Constants System” of “constant
temperature, constant humidity, constant oxygen, constant cleanliness, and constant quietness.” The Group’s first
pilot project, Shanghai Haiyue Mansion ( 上 海 海 閱 首 府 ), primarily adopts a technology-empowered residential
system comprising air source heat pumps, high-efficiency heat recovery dehumidifying fresh air units, capillary
tubing networks, and self-control systems, which is designed to provide property owners with a high-quality living
experience.
•    恆溫：除極端氣候外，住宅室內環境溫度保持為夏季小於 26℃，冬季大於 20℃，溫度場均衡，室內垂
     直溫差小於 3℃，且無吹風感；
     Constant Temperature: Except in extreme climates, the indoor temperature remains below 26°C in summer
     and above 20°C in winter. The temperature distribution is balanced, with a vertical temperature difference of
     less than 3°C, without the presence of wind;
•    恆濕：通過全效新風的除濕加濕系統自動調節室內濕度，將住宅室內環境適度保持在 30%~70% 之間（除
     極端氣候外），有效對抗梅雨季的潮濕和冬季的乾燥環境；
     Constant Humidity: The highly efficient system automatically adjusts the indoor humidity using a fresh air
     dehumidification and humidification system, maintaining the indoor environment at a moderate level of 30%
     to 70% (except in extreme climates), effectively countering the humidity of the rainy season and the dryness
     of winter;
•    恆氧：新風系統全屋覆蓋，即使在不開窗的前提下，亦可保持室內空氣流動，約每 2 小時置換一次室
     內空氣，維持室內空氣鮮活；
     Constant Oxygen: The fresh air system covers the entire housing unit, and ensures indoor air circulation
     even with windows closed. The system replaces the indoor air approximately every 2 hours, maintaining fresh
     and lively air quality;
•    恆潔：通過新風湖及下送上排的新風系統有效隔離霧霾、過敏原等污染物，保持室內空氣潔淨如新；
     Constant Cleanliness: The fresh air system effectively isolates pollutants such as smog and allergens through
     the use of a fresh air system with bottom supply and top exhaust, keeping the indoor air as clean as new;
•    恆靜：通過毛細管輻射系統、同層排水系統，減少室內設備、管道的噪音影響，並配備高性能門窗隔絕，
     室外噪音打造室內相對安靜的環境。
     Constant Quietness: The capillary radiation system and same-floor drainage systems are installed to
     minimize the noise from indoor equipment and pipelines. Additionally, high-performance windows are
     installed to block outdoor noise, creating a relatively quiet indoor environment.

                                                     打造靜謐住宅
                                             Building Tranquil Residences

 為提升住宅項目隔聲降噪性能，增強產品競爭力，本集團針對噪聲源採取全面噪聲控制解決方案，涵蓋分
 戶牆、樓板、外窗、入戶門、戶內門、排水、空調等方面，構建多層次、全方位隔音降噪系統，為居民營造
 寧靜舒適生活環境。
 To enhance the soundproofing and noise reduction performance of our residential projects and strengthen
 product competitiveness, the Group has introduced a comprehensive noise control solution targeting various
 sources of noise pollution, which covers partition walls, floor slabs, exterior windows, entry doors, interior doors,
 plumbing, and air conditioning systems to establish a multi-layered and all-around sound insulation system,
 creating a tranquil and comfortable living environment for residents.

 •       分戶牆體：將傳統隔牆與輕質牆全面升級為全現澆混凝土，隔離鄰居產生的噪音；
         Partition walls: Traditional walls and lightweight walls are upgraded to full-pour concrete walls to isolate
         noise generated between neighbouring units;

 •       樓板：在樓板結構中添加聚氨酯橡膠隔振墊，隔離上層住戶活動產生的噪音；
         Floor slabs: Polyurethane rubber vibration-damping pads are added into the floor structure to reduce
         noise from upper-level residents’ activities;

 •       外窗：採用中空夾膠三層玻璃，降低外界喧囂與車輛噪聲，隔音效果優於普通雙層中空玻璃；
         Exterior windows: Hollow triple-glazed glass is utilised with interlayer lamination to minimize outdoor
         noise and vehicle sounds, providing superior sound insulation compared to standard double-glazed hollow
         glass;

 •       入戶門：配備自動下壓條，增加門底部密封性，隔離走廊噪音；
         Entry doors: Automatic door sweeps are equipped to enhance door bottom sealing and isolate corridor
         noise;

 •       戶內門：增設橋洞力學板、靜音門鎖、自動下壓密封條、雙密封條等，確保門密封性良好；
         Interior doors: Fitted with acoustic bridges, silent door locks, automatic door sweeps, and double sealing
         strips to ensure excellent door sealing performance;

 •       排水：採用吸聲棉和隔聲氈包裹排水管，減少排水管落水聲；
         Plumbing: Drainage pipelines are covered with sound-absorbing felt and acoustic felt to reduce the noise
         of water falling through pipes;

 •       空調：選用高端品牌，並在室內機與風口間設置帆布軟連接，使用彈性減震吊架，降低空調運行噪音。
         Air conditioning: High-end brands air conditioning systems are selected and installed with canvas soft
         connections between indoor units and vents, along with flexible vibration-damping mounts, to minimize
         operating noise of air conditioning systems.

                                                    傳承中華文化
                                      Preserving and Passing on Chinese Culture

 2024 年，本集團創新「詩意東方」新中式風格，通過營造詩情畫意、傳統元素轉譯、借鑒中華紋樣等獨特手
 法，深度融合傳統文化元素。
 In 2024, the Group innovated a new Chinese style “Shiyi Dongfang* ( 詩 意 東 方 )”, extensively integrating
 traditional cultural elements with unique methods such as creating poetic and picturesque scenes, translating
 traditional elements, and referencing Chinese patterns.

 •       營造詩情畫意：把意境畫面轉譯成生活空間。使得當代人能夠身臨其境地「重返」古詩詞中的東方雅
         趣情景。
         Creating poetic and picturesque scenes: Scenic imagery is transformed into living spaces, allowing
         modern consumers to immerse themselves in the elegant charm of classical Chinese poetry and return to
         its oriental elegance.

 •       傳統元素轉譯：建築穹窿形狀的天花稱之為「藻井」，被視為尊貴的象徵，在大門無雨落客區設計中
         融合「藻井」造型；燈籠是中國人記憶中萬家燈火、張燈結彩的美好象徵，在建築設計中採用燈籠元素，
         營造溫馨氛圍。

         fond memories of “thousands of households lighting up” and festive decorations, are used in the

                                                        精細化設計
                                                      Refined Design

 本集團通過創新設計和技術應用，打造具有差異化、精細化特點的戶型與功能模塊，以更好地滿足市場變
 化和客戶需求。
 The Group has adopted innovative designs and technical applications to create differentiated and refined unit
 layouts and functional modules, better addressing market changes and customer needs.

 •       在空間設計方面：增加轉角採光與朝陽房間；利用轉角飄窗擴大視野；改變傳統餐廚佈局，實現套內「零」

         In spatial design: Corner windows and sunlit rooms are added. Corner bay windows are used to
         maximise the view. Traditional dining and kitchen layouts are redesigned to achieve a “zero corridor”
         within the unit, creating a more spacious environment. Corner partitions are strategically placed to reduce
         visual obstruction.

 •       在品質提升方面：陽台多元化利用，客廳外陽台可做咖啡角、泡茶區、活力健身、萌寵樂園等，臥室

         於玄關、廚房、走道等空間設置小儲藏間，增加儲藏空間；採取主臥小家化策略，增加書房、休閑等
         功能；在公區設置入戶花園，或將花園內嵌於戶型中。
         In quality enhancement: Balcony functionalities are diversified, with the living room balcony serving as
         a coffee corner, tea zone, fitness zone, or pet-friendly park, and the bedroom balcony functioning as a
         study area, leisure corner, or relaxation tub. Separate wet and dry areas are introduced in bathrooms to
         improve the low traditional bathroom efficiency. Storage compartments are added in entryways, kitchens,
         and hallways to increase storage space. A “personalization” strategy is adopted for master bedrooms,
         incorporating study and leisure functionalities. An entry garden is set within the communal area or
         integrated directly into the unit layout.

                                               新技術應用
                                      Adoption of New Technologies

建築信息化模型 (BIM)
Building Information Modelling (BIM)

本集團於項目中應用 BIM 技術，在施工圖設計階段，借助參數化、三維可視手段深化設計，提前發現隱患
並解決，減少後期拆改成本，同時配合研發的 CAD、Revit 及網頁管理平台對項目文件、流程、進度、質量
進行把控，助力項目品質與效益提升。
The Group adopts the BIM technology in its projects. During the construction drawing design phase, we utilise
parameterization and 3D visualisation tools to enhance the design process, allowing us to identify and address
potential issues in advance so as to reduce costly rework in later stages. In addition, supported by our internally-
developed CAD, Revit, and web-based management platforms, we are able to maintain comprehensive control
over project documentation, workflows, progress, and quality standards, ultimately improving project quality and
enhancing efficiency.


裝配式建築技術
Prefabricated Construction Technology

•     空心板疊合剪力牆技術 (EVE)
      Hollow Slab Composite Shear Wall (EVE) Technology

      本集團於項目中應用 EVE 技術，該技術因取消鋼筋套筒灌漿連接施工，無需進行套筒和連接鋼筋對位，
      安裝速度快。通過新技術的應用，簡化構件加工工藝、提高現場施工效率、保證質量可控，並且可以
      實現冬季施工，以縮短工期。
      The Group adopts the EVE technology in its projects, which eliminates the need for grouted sleeve
      connections between rebars, avoiding the alignment of sleeves and connecting rebars, thereby achieving
      faster installation. The adoption of this innovative technology simplifies the component fabrication process
      techniques, improves on-site construction efficiency, and ensures quality control and feasible winter
      construction, shortening the overall construction period.

                                                      新技術應用
                                             Adoption of New Technologies

 •       空心疊合剪力牆技術 (EMC)
         Hollow Composite Shear Wall (EMC) Technology

         本集團於項目中應用 EMC 技術，該技術採用波紋管代替灌漿套筒，大直徑鋼筋替代多根小直徑鋼筋，
         避免灌漿套筒冬季施工困難的問題，提高鋼筋連接的便捷性，實現「降低成本、提升質量、提高構件
         加工及施工效率、優化工期」的實施效益。
         The Group has adopted EMC technology in its projects, which replaces grouted sleeves with corrugated
         ducts and uses large-diameter rebars to substitute for multiple smaller ones, effectively addressing the
         challenges of grouting in winter construction, while enhancing the ease of rebar connection. Therefore,
         various benefits are achieved, including “cost reduction, quality improvement, increased efficiency in
         component fabrication and on-site construction, and overall optimisation of the construction period”.


 •       預製電梯基坑底座
         Prefabricated Elevator Pit Base

         相比整體式電梯基坑，預製電梯基坑底座採用疊合的方式減輕構件重量；該構件減小側壁高度，著
         重解決底板部分由於桶模封閉、混凝土無法振搗密實而產生的電梯底坑滲漏風險。
         Compared with monolithic elevator pits, the prefabricated elevator pit base adopts a composite structure
         to reduce the weight of the component. The design lowers the height of the side walls and primarily
         addresses the risk of water leakage in the elevator pit base caused by inadequate concrete compaction due
         to the enclosed formwork at the bottom slab.


 石膏基自流平地坪
 Gypsum-Based Self-Levelling Flooring

 本集團在具備條件的項目上大範圍採用石膏基自流平工藝，具有施工效率高、平整度好、環保性佳、不易
 空鼓開裂等優點。該工藝採用天然石膏為主要原料，不含甲醛、乾酪素、揮發性有機物等有害物質，有助
 於減少室內空氣污染。
 The Group has extensively adopted gypsum-based self-levelling technology in suitable projects, which offers high
 construction efficiency, excellent surface flatness, strong environmental performance, and resistance to hollowing
 and cracking. This technology is primarily involved natural gypsum, which is free from harmful substances such as
 formaldehyde, casein, or volatile organic compounds (VOCs), thereby reducing indoor air pollution.

      performance, reduces building energy consumption, and lowers energy

      Comfort and Noise Reduction: With excellent sealing performance, the

•     光照適宜：精心挑選玻璃類型與塗層，保證充足自然光線進入室內，

 鋁包木被動窗
 Aluminium-Clad Timber Passive Windows

 本集團於項目中應用鋁包木被動窗，具有以下優勢：
 The Group has adopted aluminium-clad timber passive windows in its projects,
 as such windows demonstrate the following advantages:

 •       無縫焊接：外鋁使用無縫焊接技術，性能及美觀度均有提升
         Seamless Welding: The exterior aluminium frame adopts seamless
         welding technology, enhancing both performance and appearance

 •       隔熱節能：鋁木之間採用導熱系數極低的工程塑料，可以阻斷熱量傳
         遞，提高產品隔熱保溫效果
         Thermal Insulation and Energy Efficiency: An engineering plastic with an
         extremely low thermal conductivity is used between the aluminium and
         timber layers, effectively blocking heat transfer and improving insulation
         performance

 •       通風排水：鋁材和木材之間留有一定空間，為後通風乾燥系統，能夠
         實現最大的通風換氣、等壓腔排水功效
         Ventilation and Drainage: A gap between the aluminium and timber
         components forms a rear ventilation and drying system, allowing for
         optimal air circulation and pressure-equalised drainage                          鋁包木被動窗
                                                                                      Aluminium-Clad Timber
 •       水密性佳：採用軟硬共擠工藝，膠條與玻璃貼合緊密                                                         Passive Window
         Excellent Water Tightness: The co-extrusion of soft and hard materials

 •       乾法安裝：相比濕法安裝，此方法安裝更整潔，無手印，且降低對技

                                               過程評估體系
                                        Process Assessment System

本集團對施工過程的關鍵階段（展示區及樣板房、基礎、地下室、主體、樣板驗收、批量精裝、景觀等）進
行工程策劃、施工安全、結構安全、防滲漏、工藝觀感、工序及材料驗收、樣板先行、按圖施工、文明施
工九個維度檢查。
The Group conducts inspections of key stages in the construction process, including display areas and display
units, foundations, basements, main structures, sample inspections, bulk decoration works, and landscaping,
across nine dimensions, including project planning, construction safety, structural safety, prevention of
seepage and leakage, workmanship aesthetics, process and material acceptance, model-first implementation,
construction based on design drawings, and civilised construction.

2024 年，本集團合計對 202 個項目開展上述九個維度過程評估，採用隨機抽球的方式對項目質量安全進
行突擊檢查，對重要的結構安全、材料選型、關鍵節點採用即時原則進行實時檢查，有效提高產品品質。
In 2024, the Group carried out process assessments based on these nine dimensions for 202 projects. Under
randomised ball-drawing methods, surprise inspections were conducted on project quality and safety. Real-time
inspections were conducted on critical aspects such as structural safety, material selection, and key construction
milestones, thereby effectively enhancing product quality.

                                                    交付評估體系
                                             Delivery Assessment System

 本集團搭建「9A 交付體系」，在項目交付前聘請專業第三方公司從承諾一致性、產品舒適性、客訴輿情、
 建築、景觀、公區、質量、防滲漏、工藝觀感九個維度，對項目進行嚴格的全面檢查。
 The Group has established the “9A Delivery System”, under which a professional third-party company is
 engaged prior to project delivery to conduct thorough and stringent inspections across nine dimensions:
 consistency commitment, product comfort, customer complaints and public opinion, architecture, landscaping,
 communal areas, quality, prevention of seepage and leakage, and workmanship aesthetics.

 2024 年，本集團累計對 87 個項目運用「9A 交付體系」進行檢查，最大程度上保證產品安全性和品質。在項
 目交付後 90 天，本集團亦對項目公區的維護、設施設備的運行情況進行定期自查和第三方不定期飛檢，
 並自建保修辦團隊，以快速響應業主的維修需求。
 In 2024, the Group applied the 9A Delivery System to inspect a total of 87 projects, maximising product safety
 and quality assurance. Within 90 days after project delivery, the Group also conducts regular internal checks and
 unscheduled third-party inspections on the maintenance of communal areas and the operation of facilities and
 equipment. In addition, the Group has established its own warranty service teams to respond promptly to repair
 requests from property owners.

                                                        設置整改基金
                                             Establishment of Rectification Funds

 •      「優改基金」用於交付後一年內新産生的不可預見問題的整改；
        The “Quality Enhancement Fund” is allocated to rectify unforeseeable issues arising within one year after
        delivery;

 •      「關愛基金」用於交付兩年後項目的提升、整改。
        The “Care Fund” is used to support improvements and rectification work for projects two years after
        delivery.

                                      營銷責任到人
                Assigning Marketing Responsibility to Designated Individuals

•   銷售人員需嚴格按照說辭標準對外輸出，不得誇大和隨意承諾；置業顧問每月底填寫《置業顧問行
    為底線風險排查確認表》，由項目營銷負責人確認；
    Sales personnel are required to strictly adhere to the standardised sales presentations when
    communicating externally, and are prohibited from exaggerating or make arbitrary commitments.
    Property consultants shall complete the “Property Consultant Behavioural Risk Investigation Confirmation
    Form” by the end of each month, which requires confirmation by the project marketing manager;

•   如營銷招標合同金額超過人民幣 10 萬元，則投標人須簽署誠信守法承諾書。
    If the marketing tender contract amount exceeds RMB100,000, bidders are required to sign an
    undertaking of honesty and legal compliance.


                                          宣傳物料審核
                                   Promotional Materials Review

•   採取「三審三校」審查流程，嚴格把控宣傳與營銷信息的準確性、真實性與合規性；
    A “Three Reviews and Three Checks” review process is adopted to rigorously ensures the accuracy,
    authenticity, and compliance of promotional and marketing materials;

•   使用「品牌落地推廣審批系統」加強對一線日常宣傳內容的檢查；
    The “Brand Localisation Promotion Review System” is used to strengthen the inspection of routine
    promotional contents at the frontline business operations;

•   統一授權方式對各單位官微公衆號、視頻號等平台賬號進行年審管理。
    A unified authorisation approach is adopted to conduct annual reviews and management of official
    WeChat public accounts, video accounts, and other platform accounts of each unit.


                                            銷售風險排查
                                       Sales Risk Investigation

•   內部檢查：針對銷售合同文本、銷售物料、銷售展示等風險開展不定期開展集團層面、集群層面及
    事業部層面的檢查與抽查；
    Internal Review: Irregular inspections and spot checks are conducted on sales contracts, promotional
    materials, sales displays, etc., at the group, cluster, and business division levels to identify risks;

•   外部檢查：針對銷售說辭、宣傳物料、銷售服務質量標準、交付前的承諾一致等進行風險排查；
    External Review: Risk investigations are conducted into sales presentations, promotional materials, sales
    service quality standards, pre-delivery commitments, and others;

•   通過 AI 大模型識別客戶接待話術的承諾風險。
    An AI model is utilised to identify potential commitment risks in customer service conversations.

                                                        節水管理
                                             Water Conservation Management

 •       定期檢查和維護用水設施，更換為節水型器具，防止滴漏現象；
         Regular inspections and maintenance of water facilities are conducted, including replacing them with
         water-saving fixtures to prevent leakage;

 •       內部宣傳節約用水，在用水區域設置節約標識；
         Water conservation practices are promoted internally by displaying water conservation signs in water-use
         areas;

 •       保潔用清洗後的無污染水澆花，實現水資源二次利用。
         Non-contaminated recycled water from cleaning is used for plant irrigation to achieve the reuse of water
         resources.

                                           節能減排
                          Energy Conservation and Emissions Reduction

•   將公司辦公區域的燈具替換為節能燈，並採用環保、節能型的電器和設施；
    Lighting fixtures in office areas are replaced with energy- efficient bulbs, and environmental and energy-
    efficient appliances and facilities are installed;

•   設定空調溫度標準及開關時間，安排巡檢人員關閉不必要的電器設備，避免能源浪費；
    Standards for air conditioning temperature and operating hours are set, and patrol officers are assigned
    to keep unnecessary electrical devices powered off to prevent energy waste;

•   樓梯、衛生間、電梯廳等區域安裝智能感應開關，實現無人區域燈光自動關閉；
    Smart motion-sensor switches are installed in stairwells, restrooms, and elevator lobbies to automatically
    switch off lights in unoccupied areas;

•   定期組織能源消耗分析和評估，發現問題並制定改進措施，持續優化能源管理；
    Energy consumption analysis and evaluation are regularly organised to identify issues and formulate
    improvement measures for continuous optimisation of energy management;

•   優先選擇環保材質的輕質辦公家具，降低能源消耗和碳排放；
    Eco-friendly lightweight office furniture sets are prioritised to reduce energy consumption and carbon
    emissions;

•   倡導視頻會議和遠程辦公，減少商務出差；
    Video conferencing and remote working is encouraged to reduce business travel;

•   公務出差優先集中乘車，降低碳排放量。
    Shared transport for official business trips is prioritised to lower carbon emissions.


                                                循環利用
                                            Resource Recycling

•   制定資産利舊要求，定期盤點資産與辦公用品，對陳舊破損但尚可使用的物品進行二次修復、包裝，
    進行二次使用；
    Asset reuse guidelines are formulated, and regular inventories of assets and office supplies are maintained
    so that the damaged but usable items are repaired or repackaged for secondary use;

•   推廣電子文檔、在線審批流程，減少紙張使用，辦公用紙優先選擇低克重、有綠色認證的紙張，提
    倡正反面打印和紙張二次利用；
    Methods, including electronic documents and online approval processes, are encouraged to reduce paper
    consumption. Priority is given to low-grammage, environmentally certified paper for office operations,
    and double-sided printing and the reuse of paper are encouraged;

•   部分利用率較低或閑置的物品，投入至公益活動或員工活動中使用，提高利用率。
    The portion of underutilised or idle items will be utilised in charity campaigns or employee activities to
    enhance utilisation rates.

案例：北京望京養雲項目應用裝配式建築技術
Case: the Adoption of Prefabricated Construction Technology for Beijing Wangjing Yangyun Project


北京望京養雲項目採用裝配式建築技術，通過工廠預製模塊化生產並在現場拼裝，大幅縮短施工周期，實現綠色
施工的降耗增效。
The Beijing Wangjing Yangyun Project adopted the prefabricated construction technology, including factory-produced
modular components to be assembled on site, significantly reducing the construction cycle and achieving energy-efficient
and green construction.

結構階段
Structural Stage

項目採用全混凝土牆板、疊合板、預製樓梯等預製構件，優化結構拆分方案，使主體結構標準層施工周期大幅縮
短，同時減少模板架體的使用量，降低施工安全風險。相較於傳統現澆樓梯，預製結構主體施工周期縮短約 20%–
30%，顯著提升施工效率。
The project employs fully concrete walls, composite floors, and prefabricated staircases. By optimising the structural
design, the construction cycle for standard floors in the main structure has been substantially shortened. Additionally,
the use of formwork has been reduced, lowering construction safety risks. Compared to traditional cast-in-situ staircases,
the construction cycle for prefabricated structures has been reduced by approximately 20%-30%, significantly improving
construction efficiency.

二次結構階段
Secondary Structural Stage

項目採用預製蒸壓輕質混凝土板進行二次結構施工，工廠預製生產並提前排版，提高現場施工效率。相比傳統磚
塊施工，流程從「鑿毛 — 支模 — 澆築 — 砌築 — 構造柱 — 頂塞」等多道工序簡化為「預埋件 — 竪條板 — 擠漿 —
拼縫抹平」，單層工期可節省 5–7 天，優化施工流程，降低施工能源消耗與溫室氣體排放。
The project employs precast autoclaved lightweight concrete panels for secondary structure construction, with factory-
based prefabrication and pre-arranged layout planning, enhancing on-site construction efficiency. Compared to traditional
brickwork, which involves multiple steps such as roughening surfaces, formwork installation, casting, masonry, structural
column construction, and top sealing, the process is streamlined into several key stages: embedded parts installation,
vertical panel erection, mortar extrusion, and joint smoothing. This approach reduces construction time by 5-7 days per
floor, optimises workflow, and lowers both energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions.

   案例：北京望京養雲項目應用裝配式建築技術
   Case: the Adoption of Prefabricated Construction Technology for Beijing Wangjing Yangyun Project
   裝修階段
   Decoration Stage

   廚房和衛生間牆面採用預製塗裝板（矽酸鈣板），在二次結構完成後可直接定尺加工，並通過龍骨調平，減少現場
   水泥砂漿等高碳材料使用量。衛生間防水底板採用一體化托盤（熱塑地板），起居室採用架空體系，省去傳統的衛
   生間回填╱起居室打地面找平工藝，減少混凝土用量。一體化托盤可批量生產，安裝環保高效，進一步推動施工綠
   色化。
   The kitchen and bathroom walls utilise prefabricated calcium silicate boards that can be cut to size after the secondary
   structure is completed. This reduces the on-site use of high-carbon materials like cement mortar. Bathroom waterproofing
   pans use integrated trays (thermoplastic flooring), and living rooms employ a suspended system, eliminating the need for
   traditional bathroom backfilling or floor levelling. Integrated trays can be mass-produced, providing an environmentally
   friendly and efficient installation process that further promotes green construction.

                                                    光伏應用
                                             Photovoltaic Applications

 本集團積極推動光伏發電與光伏照明等節能環保技術，利用其使用壽命長、維護成本低、節能環保等優勢，
 為建築照明、供熱及公共設施提供清潔能源，優化能源結構，減少對傳統電網的依賴，並在北京、南寧、
 麗水等地取得顯著成效。通過採用光電能熱水器、屋面光伏發電系統、自發自用模式接入公共照明等措施，
 本集團大幅降低傳統能源消耗，減少碳排放，同時提高能源利用效率，降低運營成本，助力建築向綠色、
 低碳、可持續方向發展。
 The Group actively promotes energy-saving and environmentally friendly technologies such as photovoltaic
 power generation and photovoltaic lighting, leveraging their advantages of long service life, low maintenance
 costs, and eco-friendliness. These technologies are applied to provide clean energy for building lighting, heating,
 and public facilities, thereby optimising the energy structure and reducing reliance on traditional power grids.
 The Group has achieved significant results in cities such as Beijing, Nanning, and Lishui. By implementing
 measures such as solar-powered water heaters, rooftop photovoltaic power systems, and self-generated,
 self-consumed energy integrated into public lighting, the Group significantly reduces conventional energy
 consumption and carbon emissions. These efforts also enhance energy efficiency and lower operational costs,
 facilitating the transition of buildings towards green, low-carbon, and sustainable development.

                                              海綿城市設計
                                            Sponge City Design

本集團踐行海綿城市建設理念，在項目開發中廣泛應用雨水回收、中水利用及生態水景觀等綠色技術，以
提升水資源利用效率，節約水資源。通過雨水收集系統，有效匯集屋頂、地面及路面雨水，並經過淨化後
用於園林灌溉、設施清潔及其他非飲用水需求，降低自來水消耗並減輕城市排水壓力。同時，中水回收系
統將優質雜排水經過處理後循環使用，滿足廁所沖洗、園林灌溉、噴水池等需求。此外，在新建項目中，
本集團結合下凹綠地、透水鋪裝、雨水花園等海綿設施，實現雨水的儲存與緩釋，進而達到減少植物灌溉
用水，提高水資源利用率，同時截留懸浮物優化小區生態環境的多重效果。
The Group practises the sponge city concept and widely applies green technologies such as rainwater
harvesting, reclaimed water reuse, and eco-friendly water landscaping during project development to enhance
water use efficiency and conserve water. By adopting rainwater collection systems, rainwater from rooftops, the
ground and roads is effectively gathered and purified for landscape irrigation, facility cleaning, and other non-
potable water uses, thereby reducing tap water consumption and alleviating pressure on the urban drainage
system. In addition, the greywater recycling system treats high-quality domestic wastewater for reuse in toilet
flushing, landscape irrigation, and water features such as fountains. Furthermore, in new projects, the Group
incorporates sunken greenspace, permeable paving, and rain gardens to enable rainwater storage and gradual
release, thereby reducing plant irrigation water usage, improving water use efficiency, and filtering suspended
particles to enhance the ecological environment of residential communities.

案例：中國綠色建築一星級 — 南昌九龍觀唐項目
Case: China One-Star Green Building — Nanchang Jiulong Guantang Project


本集團南昌九龍觀唐項目結合實際情況將綠色建築標準融入建築設計，提升資源節約效果並優化居住環境，已獲
得中國綠色建築一星級認證，其特點主要包括：
The Group’s Nanchang Jiulong Guantang project integrates green building standards into its architectural design based
on local conditions, in order to enhance resource efficiency and optimise the living environment. The project has been
awarded the China One-Star Green Building Certification, with the following key features:

節水
Water conservation

•      按使用用途、管理單元分別設置用水計量裝置，統計用水量；
       Water meters are installed based on usage purposes and management units to monitor and record water
       consumption;
•      採用節水型器具，所有衛生器具的用水效率達到 2 級標準；
       Water-saving appliances are adopted, with all sanitary fixtures meeting level 2 water efficiency standards;
•      採用滴灌、微噴灌等節水灌溉系統；
       Water-saving irrigation systems such as drip and micro-spray irrigation are employed;
•      通過合理的竪向設計實現雨水的有效下滲、滯蓄或再利用，設置下凹綠地和屋頂綠地，年徑流總量控制率
       達 70%。
       Effective infiltration, retention, or reuse of rainwater is achieved through rational vertical design, incorporating
       sunken green spaces and rooftop greenery, with an annual runoff control rate reaching 70%.

節能
Energy conservation

•      對照明採取分區分組控制、自動調節及獨立控制；
       Lighting is managed with zoned and grouped controls, automatic adjustments, and independent operation;
•      選用配備高效電機及先進控制技術的電梯，採用變頻調速拖動方式或能量再生回饋技術，並採用電梯群控
       等節能控制措施；
       Elevators are equipped with high-efficiency motors and advanced control technologies, utilising variable frequency
       drive systems or energy regeneration feedback technology, alongside energy-saving measures such as group
       control systems for elevators;
•      圍護結構熱工性能比國家現行相關建築節能設計標準規定提高 5%；
       The thermal performance of the enclosure structure is 5% higher than that stipulated in the current national
       energy-saving design standards for buildings;
•      空調冷、熱源機組等設備能效均優於《GB50189-2015 公共建築節能設計標準》，多聯式空調製冷綜合性能系
       數 IPLV(C) 提升 8%，通風空調系統風機的單位風量耗功率降低 20%；
       The energy efficiency of air conditioning cooling and heating source units is superior to the standards specified
       in the GB50189-2015 Energy-Saving Design Standard for Public Buildings; the integrated part load value (IPLV
       (C)) of multi-split air-conditioning systems increases by 8%, and the unit power consumption of air supply fans in
       ventilation and air-conditioning systems decreases by 20%;
•      合理設置外窗可開面面積，保證良好的室內通風，降低過渡季空調系統能耗；
       The operable area of external windows is reasonably designed to ensure good indoor ventilation and reduce the
       energy consumption of air-conditioning systems during transitional seasons;
•      採用光伏發電系統，由可再生能源提供電量比例達到 9.5%。
       A photovoltaic power generation system is adopted, with 9.5% of the electricity supplied by renewable energy
       sources.

   Environmentally friendly and comfortable

   •       建築造型要素簡約，無大量裝飾性構件，500 公里以內生產的建築材料重量佔建築材料總重量的比例大於

   •       項目容積率 1%，合理開發利用地下空間，節約土地；

   •       公共建築地面停車佔地面積與其總建設用地面積的比率小於 8%；
           The ratio of ground-level parking area for public buildings to the total construction land area is less than 8%;
   •       綠地設計符合當地氣候與土壤條件，綠化覆蓋率合理，採用複層綠化方式；
           Green spaces are designed to suit local climate and soil conditions, with a reasonable greenery coverage rate
           achieved through multi-layered landscaping;
   •       玻璃幕牆的可見光反射比小於 0.3，減少對環境的光污染。
           The visible light reflectance of glass curtain walls is less than 0.3, reducing light pollution to the surrounding
           environment.

案例：中國人居環境範例獎 — 廈門洋唐居住區保障性安居工程項目
Case: China Human Settlements Environment Exemplary Award — Xiamen Yangtang Residential
Area Affordable Housing Project


本集團廈門洋唐居住區保障性安居工程項目榮獲 2023 年中國人居環境範例獎，成為全國唯一獲此殊榮的保障性住
房項目。作為福建省最大的保障性安居工程，該項目遵循中國綠色建築二星級標準，以綠色、低碳、環保設計為居
民帶來優質的居住體驗。該項目注重節水、節能與環保，採用海綿城市設計、光伏光導系統、智能垃圾處理設施等
創新措施，減少能源消耗並提高居民生活質量。同時，該項目完善周邊配套設施，打造「15 分鐘社區生活圈」，提供
豐富的教育、醫療和商業資源，進一步優化居民的生活便利性和舒適度，並通過智能安防、志願者服務等舉措，增
強社區的凝聚力和安全感，打造綠色宜居的社區環境，成為現代保障房的典範。
The Group’s Xiamen Yangtang Residential Area Affordable Housing Project was awarded the 2023 China Human
Settlements Environment Exemplary Award, making it the only affordable housing project in China to receive this
prestigious recognition. As the largest affordable housing initiative in Fujian Province, this project adheres to China’s
Two-Star Green Building Standard, delivering a high-quality living experience for residents through green, low-carbon,
and environmentally friendly design. The project places strong emphasis on water conservation, energy efficiency, and
environmental protection, adopting innovative measures such as sponge city design, daylighting systems, and intelligent
waste management facilities to reduce energy consumption and improve residents’ quality of life. In addition, the project
enhances surrounding infrastructure to create a “15-minute community living circle”, providing abundant educational,
medical, and commercial resources to further improve convenience and comfort for residents. Through smart security
systems, volunteer services and other initiatives, the project also strengthens community cohesion and safety, creating a
green and liveable environment and setting a benchmark for modern affordable housing.

   案例：超低能耗建築 — 海海閱首府項目
   Case: Ultra-Low Energy Building — Shanghai Haiyue Shoufu Project


   本集團上海海閱首府項目採用超低能耗設計，結構為裝配整體式剪力牆，外牆採用 PC 牆體矽墨烯反打保溫外牆系統
   和現澆混凝土矽墨烯免拆保溫模板一體化外牆系統，並進行無熱橋設計，配備低輻射三玻兩腔玻璃門窗。該項目安
   裝太陽能光伏發電系統，並使用能量反饋的變頻變壓 VVVF 節能電梯，有效降低空調負荷和城市熱島效應，提升能源
   效率，減少電力消耗。通過保溫與結構一體化設計，該項目解決節能性、牢固度與防火性能，外牆保溫系統確保高
   強度與耐久性，實現無空腔構造，有效避免開裂、滲水、脫落隱患，保障建築安全與長期穩定性。
   The Group’s Shanghai Haiyue Shoufu Project adopts an ultra-low energy design, featuring a prefabricated monolithic shear
   wall structure. The exterior walls utilise a PC wall graphene reverse-moulded insulated system and an integrated cast-in-
   situ concrete graphene non-demountable insulated formwork system, incorporating a thermal bridge-free design. The
   project is fitted with low-emissivity triple-glazed double-cavity glass doors and windows. The project is equipped with a
   solar photovoltaic power generation system and energy-feedback variable voltage, variable frequency (VVVF) energy-saving
   elevators, effectively reducing air conditioning loads and the urban heat island effect, while improving energy efficiency
   and cutting electricity consumption. Through an integrated insulation and structural design, the project addresses energy
   efficiency, structural strength, and fire resistance. The external wall insulation system ensures high strength and durability,
   adopts a cavity-free structure, and effectively prevents risks of cracking, water seepage, or detachment, thereby ensuring
   building safety and long-term stability.

應對氣候變化                                      Addressing Climate Change
本集團持續關注氣候變化事宜和全球議                           The Group continuously monitors climate change issues and the
程，主 動 識 別 氣 候 變 化 相 關 風 險，積 極               global agenda by actively identifying climate change-related risks,
制 定 應 對 策 略，提 升 氣 候 風 險 的 應 變 和             while formulating corresponding response strategies to enhance
抵 禦 能 力，力 求 降 低 氣 候 變 化 對 業 務 的             its adaptability and resilience, aiming to mitigate the impacts of
負 面 影 響。本 集 團 識 別 出 的 氣 候 風 險 及             climate change on its operations. The climate risks identified by
其潛在影響如下：                                    the Group and their potential impacts are as follows:


                  氣候變化帶來的急性實體風險包括颱風、極端高溫、強降水、洪災、極寒等極端天
                  氣事件，以及長期的慢性實體風險，如水資源短缺、海平面上升、全球氣溫上升等。
                  這些風險可能會增加本集團的運營成本，降低收入，並嚴重影響項目的建設進度，
                  甚至可能對本集團的基礎設施和供應鏈造成長期損害。
   實體風險           Acute physical risks caused by climate change include extreme weather such as typhoons,
  Physical risk   extreme high temperatures, severe precipitation, floods, and extreme cold, while chronic
                  physical risks encompass shortages of water resources, rising sea levels, and global
                  temperature increases. These risks may cause an increase in the Group’s operating costs
                  and a decline in its revenue, and may seriously affect the progress of project construction,
                  or even cause long-term damage to the Group’s infrastructure and supply chain.



                  在氣候變化影響日益加劇的背景下，消費者更偏好具有環保屬性、對氣候負面影響
                  較小的產品和服務。投資者與合作夥伴亦會傾向於優先選擇積極應對氣候風險的企業。
                  若本集團未能及時調整業務戰略，可能面臨市場份額下降，進而影響整體收入。
   市場風險
                  Against the backdrop of intensifying climate change impacts, consumers increasingly
                  prefer products and services with environmental attributes that have a minimal adverse
  Market risk
                  impact on the climate. This preference extends to investors and partners, who are
                  increasingly inclined to prioritise businesses that proactively manage climate risks. If the
                  Group fails to adjust its business strategy in a timely manner, it may face a decline in
                  market share, which could in turn affect overall revenue.



                  為響應氣候變化挑戰，本集團將逐步採納對氣候影響較低的技術，以替代目前可能
                  造成環境破壞的技術。此過程可能涉及高額的技術更新成本，並對現有業務模式和
                  成熟技術產生較大影響，可能帶來技術轉型的挑戰和風險。
   技術風險
                  To address the challenges of climate change, the Group will gradually adopt technologies
 Technological
                  with lower climate impacts to replace those currently in use that may harm the
     risk
                  environment. This transition may involve significant costs for technological upgrades
                  and could substantially affect existing business models and established technologies,
                  potentially resulting in challenges and risks associated with technological transformation.

                                     Tendering and bidding stage

 •    商業道德承諾：要求所有參與投標的供應商簽署誠信守法承諾書（壟斷及合同金額人民幣 10 萬以下
      合同除外），承諾不索取、不給予任何單位、人員財務或各種名義上的回扣、手續費。
      Business ethics commitment: Require all suppliers participating in the tender to sign an undertaking
      of honesty and legal compliance (excluding contracts involving monopolies and those with a value below
      RMB100,000) and to undertake not to solicit or give any financial or various nominal rebates or handling
      fees to any entity or person.

 •    産品質量安全與環保認證：供應商須提供對現場安全文明和環境管理的方案及産品合格證和檢測報告，
      優先選擇獲得 ISO 9001 質量管理體系、ISO 14001 環境管理體系、ISO 45001 職業健康體系認證的供
      應商。
      Product quality safety and environmental certification: Suppliers shall provide solutions for on-
      site safety, civilisation and environmental management as well as product certification and inspection
      reports, with preference given to suppliers certified to ISO 9001 quality management system, ISO 14001
      environmental management system and ISO 45001 occupational health system.

                                                     合同訂立階段

 •       商業道德承諾：要求擬合作的供應商簽署誠信守法承諾書（壟斷及合同金額人民幣 10 萬以下合同除
         外），承諾不索取、不給予任何單位、人員財務或各種名義上的回扣、手續費。
         Business ethics commitment: Require suppliers with the intention of cooperation to sign an
         undertaking of honesty and legal compliance (excluding contracts involving monopolies and those with a
         value below RMB100,000) and to commit not to solicit or give any financial or various nominal rebates or
         handling fees to any entity or person.

 •       明確質量與安全標準：合同條款中約定好項目質量、工期、材料、安全、管理等要求，要求質量應
         符合國家相關技術規定及環保標準，進場材料應提供産品合格證、檢測報告及廠家資質，例如所有
         産品必須通過強制性産品認證（CCC 認證）。
         Clarify quality and safety standards: The contract stipulates the quality, duration, material, safety
         and management requirements of the project, requiring that the quality should comply with the relevant
         national technical regulations and environmental standards, and that the incoming materials should be
         provided with product certificates, inspection reports and manufacturer’s qualifications. For example, all
         products must pass mandatory product certification (CCC certification).

 •       建設施工保障險：要求供應商在工程開工前，為建設工程和施工場地內的自有人員及第三方人員辦
         理生命財産保險，同時本集團投保「建築工程一切險」，加強對工程的保障。
         Construction protection insurance: Suppliers are required to obtain life and property insurance for
         their own personnel and third-party personnel in the construction works and construction sites before the
         commencement of the works, while the Group takes out “All Risks Insurance for Construction Works” to
         enhance protection for the works.

 •       保障勞工權益：以項目為單位建立保障農民工工資支付協調機制和工資拖欠預防機制，督促施工總
         承包單位加強勞動用工管理，妥善處理相關的矛盾糾紛；設立農民工工資專用賬戶，按照合同約定
         及時撥付工程款，加強對施工總承包單位按時足額支付農民工工資的監督。
         Protection of labour rights: Establish a project-based coordination mechanism to ensure wage payment
         of migrant workers and a wage arrears prevention mechanism, urge construction general contractors
         to strengthen labour management, and properly handle related conflicts and disputes; set up a special
         account for migrant workers’ wages, allocate project funds in a timely manner in accordance with the
         contract, and strengthen supervision of construction general contractors in paying migrant workers’
         wages in full and on time.


                                                      施工配合階段
                                             Construction coordination stage

 •       第三方評估檢查：採用「飛檢 + 陪檢專家制」，嚴格按照國家標準、甚至高於國家標準對在建項目執
         行檢查，並將檢查結果排名與公示；監理及項目部對施工現場的材料進行抽樣送檢，規範材料進場、
         報驗、驗收等各個環節，並對過程出現的問題及時糾偏，對不合格材料進行退場處理並處罰。
         Third-party evaluation and inspection: Adopt the “inspection + accompanying inspection expert
         system” to carry out inspections of projects under construction in strict accordance with national standards,
         or even higher than national standards, and ranking and publicising the inspection results; the Supervisor
         and the projects division conduct sampling and inspection of materials at the construction site, regulate
         the various aspects of material entry, inspection and acceptance, and rectify any problems that arise in the
         process in a timely manner, and withdraw unqualified materials from the site and impose penalties.

                                          管理層測評及溝通機制
                            Management evaluation and communication mechanism

 •       定期舉辦管理層 360°考核測評，收集員工對其所在公司團隊建設和管理層品德作風、團隊管理等多
         維度的評價與建議；
         We regularly hold 360° assessment and evaluation for management to collect employees’ multi-
         dimensional comments and suggestions on team building, management ethics and style, team
         management, etc.;
 •       不定期組織管理層及員工訪談，加強溝通。
         Management and employee interviews are conducted on an ad hoc basis to strengthen communication.


                                      試用期管理溝通機制
                Management communication mechanism during the probationary period

 •       為新員工設立導師，並建立「1-3-6」試用期面談機制，即分別在員工入職第 1、3、6 個月時，組織員
         工、導師、分管領導等人員進行面談，關心新員工的工作狀態和心態，同時收集新員工的建議。
         We assign mentors to new employees and establish a “1-3-6” probation interview mechanism, arranging
         interviews in the first, third, and sixth months of employment with the employee, mentor, and responsible
         leader to understand the new employee’s work status and mindset, and to gather their feedback.


                                                    高級管理層面談
                                             Senior management interviews

 •       組織集團聘任試用期內的管理人員與集團高級管理層進行面談，了解一線工作開展情況及人員適應
         情況；
         We organise interviews between newly appointed managers during their probationary period and the
         Group’s senior management to understand frontline work progress and their adaptation;
 •       根據需要不定期組織管理人員、員工與高級管理層進行面談交流，促進團隊融合。
         If necessary, the Company will organise management and employees to conduct interviews and
         exchanges with the Company’s management team from time to time to promote team integration.

                                         工作會議機制
                                  Working meeting mechanism

•   設有定期 / 非定期工作會議機制，並視議題需要安排管理層及員工參加。該機制通過現場面對面會議、
    視頻會議等溝通方式決策集團經營事項。
    The Group has established a regular/non-regular working meeting mechanism and arranges management
    and employees to attend the meetings when necessary. The mechanism makes decisions on the Group’s
    operational matters through face-to-face meetings and video conferences.

                              Interviews and satisfaction surveys

•   工會、團委不定期的開展青年員工訪談、滿意度調研等工作，了解員工思想動態與對本集團的建議。
    The labour union and the Youth League Committee irregularly carry out interviews with young employees
    and satisfaction surveys to understand employees’ thoughts and suggestions to the Group.

    encourage employees to voice out their opinions.

案例：管培生入職集訓
Case: Management Trainee Onboarding Training


2024 年 7 月，本集團組織 2024 屆管培生入職集訓，202 位來自房地產開發業務、建發物業和建發合誠的管培生參與。
集訓聚焦企業文化、品牌理念、業務發展與運營實踐，通過豐富多樣的形式，包括高管授課、團隊拓展、項目參觀、
知識競賽等，全方位幫助新員工深入了解企業，快速融入團隊，切身感受集團的匠心精神和業務魅力，為實現從「校
園人」到「建發人」的角色轉換奠定基礎。
In July 2024, the Group organised onboarding training for the cohort of management trainees for 2024, with 202
management trainees from the property development business, C&D Property, and C&D Holsin participating. The
training focused on corporate culture, brand philosophy, business development, and operational practices. A wide
range of methods were used, including lectures by senior executives, team-building activities, site visits, and knowledge
competitions. These initiatives aimed to help new employees gain a comprehensive understanding of the Company,
integrate quickly into their teams, and personally experience the Group’s craftsmanship spirit and business appeal, laying a
solid foundation for their transition from “campus talents” to “C&D professionals.”

   案例：城市總經理和項目總經理培訓
   Case: City General Manager and Project General Manager Training


   2024 年 4 月，本集團舉辦城市總經理和項目總經理培訓，聚焦制度標準落地、核心能力提升和技術要求，共 137 人
   參與。為期三天的培訓通過項目參觀、集中授課和行動學習等形式，涵蓋制度標準解析、客戶敏感點分析、項目經
   營與管理以及技術落地等內容。各小組圍繞「四層級工作目標與重點」進行研討並匯報，進一步明確項目管理核心任務，
   為推動制度落地、提升管理水平和實現項目目標奠定堅實基礎。
   In April 2024, the Group conducted a training session for city general managers and project general managers, focusing
   on the implementation of systems and standards, core competency enhancement, and technical requirements, with 137
   participants in total. The three-day training, delivered through project visits, centralised lectures, and action learning,
   covered topics such as system and standard analysis, customer pain point analysis, project operations and management,
   and technical implementation. Each group conducted discussions and presentations centred on the “four-tiered work
   objectives and priorities”, further clarifying the core responsibilities of project management. This laid a solid foundation for
   driving system implementation, elevating management standards, and achieving project goals.

 案例：工程管理專項培訓
 Case: Specialised Training in Engineering Management


 2024 年 4 月，本集團開展第六期工程現場教學，圍繞預應力管樁、灌注樁成樁判定及管控要點，通過原理講解、現
 場示範和交流研討，向 33 名項目工程責任人進行培訓。學員們深入學習預應力管樁及灌注樁成樁控制、施工組織與
 材料驗收管理及風險控制的關鍵要點，並根據所學內容制定項目改善計劃，確保培訓成果轉化落地，切實提升項目
 工程責任人專業能力，為項目管理提供了有力支持。
 In April 2024, the Group held its sixth engineering on-site training session, focusing on prestressed pipe piles and cast-
 in-place pile formation assessment and control essentials. Through theoretical explanations, on-site demonstrations, and
 interactive discussions, the training was delivered to 33 project engineering supervisors. Participants engaged in in-depth
 learning on key aspects such as control of pile formation for prestressed and cast-in-place piles, construction organisation,
 material acceptance management, and risk control. Based on the training content, attendees developed project
 improvement plans to ensure the effective application of training outcomes. This initiative significantly strengthened the
 professional capabilities of project engineering leaders and provided robust support for project management.

   案例：職能中心開放日
   Case: Functional Centre Open Day


   2024 年 4 月，本集團舉辦首期「職能中心開放日」，35 名近兩年新入職的部門經理及項目經理以上級別人員參加，旨
   在促進新幹部融入，增強文化認同與歸屬感。培訓聚焦企業文化、廉潔自律、合規審計、產品介紹和工程底線等內容，
   通過高管交流、講師授課及項目參觀等形式，全面提升學員對公司業務的理解與認同，並推動其在自我管理、溝通
   方向、團隊建設、業務推動等方面持續精進提升，為後續工作提供寶貴啟發。
   In April 2024, the Group held its first “Functional Centre Open Day”, attended by 35 newly hired department and
   project managers (or above) who joined within the past two years. The event aimed to promote integration among new
   managers and enhance their cultural alignment and sense of belonging. The training focused on topics including corporate
   culture, integrity and self-discipline, compliance and auditing, product overview, and engineering standards. Through
   executive exchanges, expert lectures, and site visits, the programme significantly enhanced participants’ understanding and
   recognition of the Group’s business, and provided valuable insights into self-management, communication, team building,
   and business development.

員工培訓考核機制
Employee Training Assessment Mechanism


                •    凡培訓必考試，設置 80 分通過線；
                     All training sessions require examinations, with a passing score set at 80 points;
                •    內部通報考試情況，補考未通過及缺考學員需重新學習並參加補考；
                     Examination results are internally reported; participants who fail the make-up
                     examination or miss the initial examination must re-study and take a supplementary
                     examination;
                •    學員的培訓記錄、考試記錄、答辯考核結果將形成培訓檔案，作為考核和晉升的
                     重要參考依據。
                     Training records, examination results, and assessment presentations will be compiled
                     into individual training files, serving as important references for performance

 內部講師積分考核機制
 Internal Trainer Point-Based Assessment Mechanism


                         •        根據課程類型及學員評價，按標準發放積分獎勵，課程開發與授課均設置明確激
                                  勵規則，激勵力度隨課程質量與學員反饋互動；
                                  Points are awarded based on course type and participant feedback, with clear
                                  incentive rules established for both course development and delivery. The level of
                                  incentive correlates with course quality and participant interaction;
                         •        通過季度表彰和年度評優，獎勵表現優秀和知識貢獻突出的講師，激發講師積極
                                  性與參與熱情。
                                  Quarterly recognition and annual awards are granted to outstanding trainers and top
                                  knowledge contributors to further stimulate enthusiasm and active participation in
                                  internal training.


   案例：教師節「攜手贈桃李雲端共芬芳」主題活動
   Case: Teachers’ Day Themed Event —“Joining Hands to Honor Teachers”


   2024 年 9 月 10 日，本集團舉辦教師節「攜手贈桃李雲端共芬芳」主題活動，倡導「從共鳴到共識，從共識到共行」的理
   念，吸引更多員工加入講師和導師隊伍，傳承經驗、賦能企業發展。本次活動發起「作為講（導）師╱如果我是講（導）
   師，會讓我真的快樂」線上互動，共收集 424 條發帖分享，進一步強化了講師與導師的使命感與歸屬感，激勵員工在
   分享智慧中實現個人價值，推動業務持續發展。
   On 10 September 2024, the Group held a themed event for Teachers’ Day entitled “Joining Hands to Honor Teachers”,
   promoting the concept of “from resonance to consensus, from consensus to action”. The event aimed to inspire more
   employees to join the trainer and mentor teams, share their experience, and empower the Group’s development. The event
   launched an online interactive campaign titled “As a Trainer/Mentor, or If I Were a Trainer/Mentor, What Would Truly
   Make Me Happy,” collecting 424 posts and shares. This further strengthened the sense of mission and belonging among
   trainers and mentors, inspiring employees to realise personal value through sharing wisdom and driving sustained business
   growth.

安全生產目標                                                 Production Safety Objectives


                           安全管理指標目標：
                           Safety management indicator objectives:

                                   安全生産目標管理責任書簽訂率 100%；
                                    100% signing rate of production safety target management responsibility letter;
                                   年度進行考核、兌現獎懲 100%；
                                    100% completion of annual assessments and implementation of rewards and
                                    penalties;
                                   各級安全生産管理機構運作和安全記錄 100%；
                                    100% operation and safety record of production safety management institutions at
                                    all levels;
                                   全年各單位安全工作主要負責人主持召開安全生産會議和解決重大問題不少於
                                    4 次；
                                    Main responsible persons for safety work in each unit presides over production
                                    safety meetings and resolves major issues not less than 4 times throughout the year;
                                   事故及時結案率 100%；
                                    100% timely incident closure rate;
                                   不發生受上級通報批評事項。
                                    Zero incidents subject to criticism by superior authorities.



                           安全生産控制指標目標：
                           Production safety control indicator objectives:

                                   特大事故、重大事故為 0；
                                    Zero major or catastrophic incidents;
                                   一般事故死亡率為 0；
                                    Zero fatalities in general incidents;
                                   直接經濟損失超人民幣 100 萬元為 0；
                                    Zero incidents resulting in direct economic losses exceeding RMB1 million;
                                   傷害人數 10 人以上或出現死亡病例的食品安全事故為 0。
                                    Zero food safety incidents involving 10 or more injuries or any fatalities.

 本 集 團 要 求 所 有 業 務 經 營 單 位、安 全 管   The Group requires all business units, designated safety
 理責任人及施工單位在工程開展前簽訂                 managers, and construction contractors to sign a Production

 安全責任，切實保障施工安全。                    any project, in order to clearly define safety responsibilities and
                                   effectively ensure construction safety.

本集團高度重視施工中的高安全風險隱                  The Group places great emphasis on the management of high-
患，規 定 軟 土 場 地、深 基 坑、高 邊 坡 等        risk construction hazards. For support and earthworks involving

案 需 經 專 家 論 證、報 集 群 審 批 通 過 後 方    high slopes, construction plans must undergo expert review
可 施 工，重 點 關 注 基 坑 邊 超 荷 堆 載、大      and obtain approval from the cluster before commencement.
型機械、高大模板、外架、臨邊洞口、高                 Key attention is paid to risks including excessive loading at pit
墜及物體打擊等高風險隱患排查。同時，                 edges, large machinery, tall formwork, external scaffolding,
本集團引入裝配式建築等工業化生產技                  open edges, falls from height, and object strikes. In addition, the
術，例 如 以 ALC 板 構 件 運 輸 安 裝、施 工      Group has adopted industrialised production technologies such
機械化程度高的特性減低人力操作風險，                 as prefabricated construction. For example, the use of Autoclaved

                                   The application of precast composite floor slab technology shifts

   案例：「潮」紅健步行活動
   Case:“Trendy”Red Walk Event


   2024 年 7 月，本集團在 21 個城市聯動舉辦「以奮鬥 · 致初心」第二屆「潮」紅健步行活動。此次活動吸引了近 470 名員
   工參與，徒步結合黨史學習、企業文化知識問答、歌曲演唱等形式，深化了廉政條例和企業文化的學習，激勵員工
   傳承艱苦奮鬥精神，踐行「以客戶為中心」的理念，在不同發展階段勇於開拓進取，與企業攜手共進、共同成長。
   In July 2024, the Group held the second “Trendy” Red Walk event under the theme “Striving for Our Original Aspiration”
   in 21 cities. This event attracted nearly 470 employees, combining a walk with activities such as Party history education,
   corporate culture quizzes, and song performances. It deepened understanding of integrity regulations and corporate
   culture, inspiring employees to carry forward the spirit of perseverance and uphold the “customer-centric” philosophy,
   motivating them to be enterprising at all stages of development and grow together with the Group.

案例：全民健身活動
Case: National Fitness Activities


為積極響應全民健身號召，本集團工會及下屬工會廣泛開展各類全民健身活動、運動會、運動興趣協會活動。僅廈
門地區，全年就有超過 3,000 人次參與游泳健身興趣小組，超過 1,000 人次參與羽毛球、籃球、足球協會的技藝切磋，
共同感受運動的魅力與樂趣，不僅提升員工的身體素質，還進一步增強團隊凝聚力，營造了勞逸結合、健康向上的
文化氛圍。
In response to the national fitness campaign, the Group’s labour union and its subsidiaries actively organised various fitness
programs, sports games, and interest-based athletic clubs. In Xiamen alone, over 3,000 employees participated in the
swimming fitness interest group throughout the Year, while more than 1,000 employees took part in technical exchanges
within the badminton, basketball, and football associations. These activities allowed employees to experience the charm
and joy of sports, improving their physical fitness while further strengthening team cohesion, fostering a culture of work-
life balance and healthy positivity.

   案例：企業文化活動
   Case: Corporate Culture Activities


   為深化企業文化傳播，本集團刊發 7 期《行動》簡報，鼓勵管理人員通過行動學習推動提質增效，堅定執行工作計劃。
   同時，本集團提煉信息化建設、新中式研發、以客戶為中心等企業文化故事，刊登於《建發通訊》，以沉澱管理經驗。
   在企業文化陣地「建發房產悅生活」平台，本集團推出「建發房產她力量」、一線故事「考驗」、五一特輯、國慶特輯等
   內容，展現員工立足崗位、鑄就美好生活的故事。此外，各單位圍繞新員工入職、老員工退休、榮譽員工表彰等主題，
   舉辦豐富活動，進一步傳承建發企業文化。
   To strengthen corporate culture dissemination, the Group published 7 issues of Action newsletters, encouraging
   management teams to drive quality and efficiency improvements through action learning and steadfast execution of work
   plans. In addition, the Group compiled stories reflecting its corporate culture, such as digital transformation, new Chinese-
   style R&D, and a customer-centric approach, featured in the C&D Newsletter to preserve management experience. On the
   Group’s cultural platform “C&D Real Estate Joyful Life”, a variety of themed features were launched, including “Her Power
   at C&D Real Estate”, frontline stories titled “The Test”, and holiday specials for Labour Day and National Day. These stories
   highlighted employees’ dedication to their roles and their contributions to building a better life. In addition, various units
   organised themed activities related to new employee onboarding, retirements, and honouring distinguished employees,
   further reinforcing and passing on the corporate culture of C&D.

案例：「雨潤青苗」結對幫扶活動

   案例：「有愛就有路 · 讓夢前行」慈善助學慰問活動
   Case:“Where There Is Love, There Is a Way — Let Dreams Take Flight”Education Support Program


   2024 年 8 月，本集團參與基金舉辦的「有愛就有路 · 讓夢前行」慈善助學活動，資助 92 名廈門應屆生、在校貧困大學
   生共計人民幣 50.2 萬元，助其順利完成學業。同時，本集團組織黨員志願者深入鄉鎮為受資助大學生送上慰問品、
   慰問金等關懷禮包。本年度，本集團共計投入人民幣 69.77 萬元資助 131 名大學生，為貧困學子們點燃希望之光，照
   亮前路。
   In August 2024, the Group took part in the “Where There Is Love, There Is a Way — Let Dreams Take Flight” education
   support program hosted by the Fund, providing RMB502,000 in financial aid to 92 university students in Xiamen, including
   recent graduates and current students from low-income families, helping them complete their studies. The Group also
   organised Party member volunteers to visit rural townships and deliver support to the sponsored students. During the
   Year, the Group contributed a total of RMB697,700 to support 131 university students, lighting a beacon of hope for
   underprivileged students and illuminating their path forward.

 案例：同安雲洋村農特產品產業幫扶
 Case: Agricultural Product Industry Support in Yunyang Village, Tong’an


 2024 年 9 月，本集團通過開展公益集市活動、組織成員企業和員工採購農產品等方式，積極參與同安雲洋村農特產
 品產業幫扶活動，協助雲洋村銷售雲洋手工麵線並拓寬銷售渠道，助力雲洋村產業振興。本年度，本集團助力雲洋
 村售出手工麵線超 7,500 件，共計為雲洋村財政增收人民幣 44 萬元。
 In September 2024, the Group actively participated in agricultural product support initiatives for Yunyang Village by
 organising charity markets and encouraging member enterprises and employees to purchase local agricultural products.
 These efforts supported the sales of Yunyang’s handmade noodles and helped broaden sales channels for Yunyang Village,
 thereby contributing to the village’s industrial revitalisation. During the Year, the Group facilitated the sale of over 7,500
 units of handmade noodles from Yunyang Village, generating an additional income of RMB440,000 for the village.

   案例：同安雲洋村助困助學幫扶慰問活動
   Case: Assistance and Educational Support in Yunyang Village, Tong’an


   2024 年 7 月，本集團參與「村企共建鄉村振興」幫扶活動，資助慰問同安雲洋村 47 戶困難家庭和 11 名老黨員，同時
   向雲洋村老人幸福院和衛生所捐贈電腦及其他辦公設備，共計捐贈人民幣 2.59 萬元。
   In July 2024, the Group participated in a Village-Enterprise Co-Building Rural Revitalisation support initiative, providing
   donations and care to 47 disadvantaged households and 11 senior Party members in Yunyang Village, Tong’an. The
   Group also donated computers and other office equipment to the village’s elderly care centre and health clinic, with total
   contributions amounting to RMB25,900.

   另外，本集團積極將「雲潤青苗」和「讓夢前行」等公益項目融入雲洋村幫扶工作。本年度，基於「雲潤青苗」項目，本
   集團完成對雲洋小學的 5 戶困難家庭學生資助；基於「讓夢前行」項目，完成 5 戶困難家庭大學生的資助。
   In addition, the Group actively integrated public welfare programs such as “Yurun Qingmiao ( 雨潤青苗 )” and “Let Dreams
   Take Flight” into its assistance efforts in Yunyang Village. During the year, the Group completed the financial assistance
   to five students from needy families in Yunyang Primary School under the “Yurun Qingmiao ( 雨 潤 青 苗 )” program,
   and completed the financial assistance to five college students from needy families under the “Let Dreams Take Flight”
   program.

共築生態家園                                              Building Ecological Communities
在 城 市 建 設 與 發 展 進 程 中，本 集 團 始 終                     In the process of urban construction and development, the Group
秉持著對自然生態與歷史文化的尊重和                                   consistently upholds a commitment to respecting and preserving
保護理念，通過科學合理的規劃與舉措，                                  natural ecosystems and historical culture. Through scientifically
不 僅 為 城 市 留 住 歲 月 的 印 記，也 為 居 民                     sound planning and measures, it not only preserves the marks of
創 造 了 更 具 品 質 的 生 活 環 境，讓 自 然 與                     time for cities but also creates higher-quality living environments
人文之美在現代社區中得以延續和升華。                                  for residents, allowing the beauty of nature and culture to endure
                                                    and flourish in modern communities.

 案例：為 400 年古榕樹煥發新生機
 Case: Rejuvenating a 400-Year-Old Banyan Tree


 為保護龍岩新羅區建發縵雲項目內一株樹齡逾 400 年的古榕樹，本集團將其原地保留，並在樹池周邊設置架空木平台，
 此舉既能保障古樹良好的疏水透氣性，又為社區居民打造休憩空間。同時，本集團以古樹為核心，向小區四面貫通
 並實施微改造，營造出兼具自然與歷史韵味的美學環境，讓居民得以感受美的熏陶，也賦予古樹在社區中的全新生機。
 To protect a 400-year-old banyan tree located at the C&D Manyun project site in Xinluo District, Longyan, the Group
 preserved the tree in its original location and constructed an elevated wooden platform around its base. This approach
 not only ensures proper drainage and ventilation for the tree but also provides a rest area for community residents.
 Furthermore, the Group implemented a series of micro-renovations centred around the tree, integrating it into the fabric of
 the residential environment. This created an aesthetically rich setting that combines natural and historical charm, offering
 residents a space of aesthetic inspiration and granting the ancient tree renewed vitality within the community.

  室租賃。中國的辦公室租賃通常初                     offices in the PRC. The leases of offices in the PRC typically
  步為期 2 至 20 年。概無租賃包含可                run for an initial period of 2 to 20 years. None of the leases
  變租賃款項。若干租賃包含在合約                     includes variable lease payments. Certain leases include an
  期限結束後將租賃續期的額外選                      option to renew the lease for an additional period after
  擇權。本集團於租賃開始日期評估                     the end of the contract term. The Group assesses at lease
  是否合理確定行使續租選擇權，並                     commencement date whether it is reasonably certain to
  斷定並非合理確定行使續租選擇                      exercise the extension options and concluded that it is
  權。因此，續租期間的未來租賃款                     not reasonably certain to exercise the extension options.
  項不計入使用權資產計量。                        Accordingly, the future lease payments during the extension
                                      periods are not included in the measurement of the right-
                                      of-use assets.

        本集團根據合約所訂條款向客戶                                     The Group receives payments from customers based on
        收取付款。有關付款一般於履行合                                    the terms established in contracts. Payments are usually

45. 資本管理                        45. CAPITAL MANAGEMENT
   本集團的資本管理旨在確保本集                  The Group’s capital management objectives are to ensure
   團有能力持續經營，並透過因應風                 the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern and
   險水平調整貨品及服務的定價，為                 to provide an adequate return to shareholders by pricing
   股東帶來充足回報。                       goods and services commensurately with the level of risk.

   本集團積極定期審查資本架構，並                 The Group actively and regularly reviews its capital structure
   就經濟情況變動作出調整。本集團                 and makes adjustments in light of changes in economic
   以淨負債權益比率為基準監察資                  conditions. The Group monitors its capital structure on the
   本架構。就此目的淨負債按借款減                 basis of the net debt to equity ratio. For this purpose, net
   銀行及手頭現金計算。為維持或調                 debt is defined as borrowings less cash at banks and on
   整該比率，本集團可能調整向股東                 hand. In order to maintain or adjust the ratio, the Group
   派付的股息、發行新股、向股東退                 may adjust the amount of dividends paid to shareholders,
   還資本、募集新債務融資或出售資                 issue new shares, return capital to shareholders, raise new
   產以減少債務。                         debt financing or sell assets to reduce debt.
